title: The parts import never saves a tracked part without a bin
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919). The Admin role has 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete' and opens Settings → Data Import.
  • No part numbered {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-NOBIN-01) exists at {Location-A}.
  • Import file {Import-file-A} has one row for {Part-A} with the grid_location cell (the import's name for Bin Location) left empty.
custom_steps:
1. Open Settings → Data Import → Inventory.
  2. Upload {Import-file-A}.
  3. Run the import.
  4. Read the message the import shows for the {Part-A} row.
  5. In the top bar click Parts, then click Inventory in the left menu.
  6. Type {Part-A} in the Search box.
  7. Click the {Part-A} row, if the list shows one.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Steps 4 and 6: Either the row is refused with "At least one bin must be provided." and no {Part-A} is listed, or the row is imported and {Part-A} is listed as a tracked part.
  • Step 7: If {Part-A} was imported, Edit Inventory Part shows "Track quantities and cost of goods" on and at least one bin location marked "Default". A tracked {Part-A} saved with no bin location at all fails the case.
  • Steps 1 to 7: The other refusals of this rule cannot be produced from the screens: a tracked part sent with bins but none marked as the default ("At least one bin must be marked as default.") and a request to turn tracking on for a part with no bin ("At least one bin must be provided."). Write "not checked by hand" for them in the result comment.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10817 (Story 4, Create an Untracked Part); story SV-10818 (Story 5, Change Tracking on an Existing Part); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, as edited 9 Oct 2026 (Ready for dev), S4-R7, S4-N1, S4-N2, S5-N1, §8 User Feedback Summary, read 13 Oct 2026; design canvas board 1.1 (New Inventory Part opens), 13 Oct copy. QA lead's 9 Oct set-up answer 2 (an import with Grid Location empty). Source-verified 13 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S4-R7: “When the switch is on, at least one bin location must be set, and one must be marked as the default, before the part can be saved.”
  • S4-N1: “If a tracked part reaches the system with no bin location, the save is refused with "At least one bin must be provided."”
  • S4-N2: “If a tracked part reaches the system with bin locations but none marked as the default, the save is refused with "At least one bin must be marked as default."”
  • S5-N1: “If a request to turn tracking on reaches the system with no bin location, it is refused with "At least one bin must be provided." The dialog never sends one, because of S5-R7.”
  • PRD Story 4 context note: “in the dialog a new part always starts with the location's default bin, and the last bin and the default bin cannot be removed, so S4-N1 and S4-N2 come from requests made outside the dialog.”
  • PRD §8 User Feedback Summary (Tracked part saved with no bin): “"At least one bin must be provided." | Error toast, fades after 3 seconds”
  • PRD §8 User Feedback Summary (Tracked part saved with no default bin): “"At least one bin must be marked as default." | Error toast, fades after 3 seconds”
  • PRD §8 User Feedback Summary (context note): “every refusal sent by the system, the rows that fade after 3 seconds, also shows a second, smaller line under the message: "Please try to resolve this."”
